Seven native workflow class families, dense, sparse, generalized, mixed and recurrence fit records. No Python pandas/dataclasses or injected Matplotlib Axes accepted; no plot fallback.

Previously fitted observed-grid FPCA and sparse PACE component lines, FoSR coefficient lines, mixed 95% pointwise Wald intervals, generalized link-scale coefficients and recurrence matrix; no hidden fitting or calibration.
Reject unknown plot types, wrong result families, omitted component or coefficient, invalid zero-based index types, multichannel dimension ambiguity and unsupported injected Matplotlib axes.
Typed etr_workflow_scientific_plot_record holding explicit canonical plot identity and underlying scientific R artist geometry. Not a real Matplotlib Axes or pixel-identical figure.
Pure workflow visualization dispatch preserving each estimator, calibrated uncertainty type and observed scientific support; no inferential estimand or optimizer is changed.
